scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @umbra/api & npm run dev -w @umbra/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @umbra/shared && npm run build -w @umbra/api && npm run build -w @umbra/web
scripts.build:prod: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @umbra/shared && npm run typecheck -w @umbra/api && npm run typecheck -w @umbra/web
